        int R = scanner.nextInt();
        int C = scanner.nextInt();
        if (R > C) {
            int temp = R;
            R = C;
            C = temp;
        }
        int[][][] dp = new int[C + 1][1 << R][1 << R];
        for (int i = 0; i <= C; i++) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << R); mask++) {
                Arrays.fill(dp[i][mask], 69);
            }
        }
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << R); mask++) {
            dp[0][0][mask] = 0;
        }
        for (int c = 1; c <= C; c++) {
            for (int prevMask = 0; prevMask < (1 << R); prevMask++) {
                for (int currMask = 0; currMask < (1 << R); currMask++) {
                    for (int nextMask = 0; nextMask < (1 << R); nextMask++) {
                        boolean valid = true;
                        for (int b = 0; b < R; b++) {
                            if ((currMask & (1 << b)) == 0) {
                                boolean neighborOccupied = false;
                                if (b > 0 && (currMask & (1 << (b - 1))) != 0) neighborOccupied = true;
                                if (b + 1 < R && (currMask & (1 << (b + 1))) != 0) neighborOccupied = true;
                                if ((prevMask & (1 << b)) != 0) neighborOccupied = true;
                                if ((nextMask & (1 << b)) != 0) neighborOccupied = true;
                                if (!neighborOccupied) {
                                    valid = false;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (valid) {
                            dp[c][currMask][nextMask] = Math.min(dp[c][currMask][nextMask], dp[c - 1][prevMask][currMask] + Integer.bitCount(prevMask));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int maxUnspiders = 0;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << R); mask++) {
            maxUnspiders = Math.max(maxUnspiders, R * C - (dp[C][mask][0] + Integer.bitCount(mask)));
        }
        System.out.println(maxUnspiders);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
